inlines.v: TIT'ULAR, adjective [Latin titulus.] 1. Existing in title or name only; nominal; having or conferring the title only; as a titular king or prince. 2. Having the title to an office or dignity without discharging the duties of it. Both Valerius and Austin were titular bishops. TIT'ULAR
